Toolfolio - All the Tools You Need in One Place

name: Toolfolio
summary: Curated directory of AI, design, no-code and productivity tools, with collections, reviews, coupon codes and paid listings.
description: A curated directory and marketplace for discovering software. Tools are organised into categories (design, AI, no-code, plugins, marketing, video, e-commerce, coding, writing, audio, photography, finance, education, security, productivity, newsletters, agents) and grouped into 'best tools' collections and review articles. Tool makers can claim or pay for listings and track views and clicks in a dashboard.
contains: directory of tools across design, AI, no-code, marketing, coding, video and more
curated collections and 'best tools' roundups (e.g. 32 vibe coding assistants)
paid listing tiers: Startup $150 one-time, Growth $250/month
boost placements with CPC and banner packs
Tools Daily newsletter and Discord community
